title: Explosions reported
description: There are already 20 injured in Chernihiv after the arrival of a Russian drone in a multi-storey building. Among them are two children: 12 and 17 years old. A 17-year-old girl and an elderly woman were hospitalized in the hospital - she is in serious condition. Another 18 people were treated by doctors - all of them are undergoing outpatient treatment. The fire has already been extinguished. Police explosives experts assume that it was a Geran-5 jet drone.
